text:
BIG-IP LTM v9.4.2
Commands Introduced in BIG-IP LTM 9.4.2
CACHE::header
- Get the content of an
Header related to an object stored in the RamCache.
PLUGIN::disable
- Disables plugin
processing on the connection.
SCTP::client_port
- Returns the SCTP
port/service number of the specified client.
SCTP::collect
- Collects the specified
amount of content data.
SCTP::local_port
- Returns the local
SCTP port/service number.
SCTP::mss
- Returns the on-wire Maximum
Segment Size (MSS) for an SCTP connection.
SCTP::payload
- Returns or replaces SCTP
data content.
SCTP::ppi
- Returns or sets the SCTP payload
protocol indicator.
SCTP::release
- Resumes processing and
flushes collected data.
SCTP::remote_port
- Returns the
remote SCTP port/service number.
SCTP::respond
- Sends the specified data
directly to the peer.
SCTP::server_port
- Returns the SCTP
port/service number of the specified server.
SIP::payload
- Returns the accumulated SIP
data content.

PERSIST_DOWN
